item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】FLAC - Karyn White – The Way I Feel About You Japan 3 Inch CD Single WPDP-6289
item.description:
This is the Japan 3 Inch CD Single for the second single, The Way I Feel About You, from her album Ritual Of Love. The single peaked at #12 on the Hot 100 & #5 on the Hot R&B Singles Chart. The Borique Version is only available on this Japan 3 Inch CD Single. I have the cassette single too but I cannot remember if it is the same version as the Spanish Mix on Side 2, and I don't own a cassette player anymore

Ripped from personal collection, hope you enjoy it.

Tracklist:

1. The Way I Feel About You (LP Version) 4:27
2. The Way I Feel About You (Borique Version) 4:13

https://www.discogs.com/release/2839171-Karyn-White-The-Way-I-Feel-About-You
